observations: Two white vertical speakers with two black drivers each.
The 'logi' brand logo is visible on the front of the left speaker in photo 0 and photo 1.
The right speaker in photo 0 and photo 1 has a power button and a volume knob with a blue LED indicator lit.
Photo 2 shows the back of the right speaker with a label.
The label in photo 2 identifies the model as S-0016 and the brand as Logitech.
The label in photo 2 also shows the input as 5V 1.5A, which is typical for a USB-powered device.

claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean, but internal components and sound quality cannot be confirmed from photos.

claims.claim: Can be used with your laptop or other devices
claims.evidence: The 5V input on the label in photo 2 indicates it is designed for USB power.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
